reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 21. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 39 (98%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

Cancer research ensures patients can beat this disease and live a full life. We've come a long way, but can't stop now.

We must give our researchers the resources they need to ensure that progress continues. https://t.co/BfUBpu0IId

Cancer patients and survivors live with fear and uncertainty because of Republicans' assault on cancer research.

We cannot take our foot off the gas in the fight against cancer. Lives are at stake. https://t.co/VDjhs7mhuF

As a lead House Appropriator for these families, it's always a top priority. https://t.co/T5MpBoSiE0

Miccosukee and Seminole Tribes fiercely guard natural wonders like the Everglades. I'll always join them to protect sacred lands and water rights. For Native American Heritage Month let's uplift the rich cultures, traditions and contributions of Indigenous communities. https://t.co/qFw4GsqbIN

Lucho no solo para proteger a nuestros vecinos venezolanos que cumplen la ley de la brutalidad del ICE, sino también para garantizarles un camino hacia la residencia permanente. Debemos aprobar la Ley de Ajuste Venezolano para lograr ese objetivo. https://t.co/6wfl7rwlLF

Americans shouldn’t suffer such gross Trump incompetence. Thanks to every air traffic controller, airline, FAA and TSA staffer working to fix grounded flights. Travelers deserve timely, safe air travel. Democrats will demand it, plus answers on what Trump did with $12.5B Congress https://t.co/Nn1yeUyIhd

So proud to welcome Florida's newest Democratic Members of Congress - Pia Dandiya and Oliver Gilbert!

They'll keep up their fantastic work for Floridians once they're sworn in January 3rd, as we all zero in on lowering costs and fighting corruption. https://t.co/o7N74AqFWK

Wonderful to talk with Washington DC Mayor-elect @CMLewisGeorgeW4 about how we will protect the District’s funding in Congress, keep fighting for statehood, and to help her and the people of Washington, DC any way I can. https://t.co/DGInwPFcn8

It's great to be back at the Capitol with all our fired up, newly elected Members.

@HouseDemocrats are hungry to lower costs and end Trump's corruption. https://t.co/jpFKC9M8dU

House Democrats passed the Major Richard Star Act to ensure wounded veterans get their full benefits - a sacred promise. Yet Republicans just marked Veterans Day by making the largest cut to veterans’ benefits ever. On Veterans Day! Democrats will never betray those who serve. https://t.co/l5d0N4D38H

Trump’s DHS hired a racist domestic abuser. He lied about his law enforcement experience, and his family says he is dangerous.

ICE let him skip basic training, gave him a firearm, and put him on patrol without a background check. Now an innocent man is dead. https://t.co/ks52qk2kjb

Glad to join bipartisan Members and Members-elect of the House of Representatives for a Veterans Day tribute.

To all our veterans — thank you for your service and dedication to our nation. https://t.co/LoLMIzmaxz

As we observe #VeteransDay, we must all recognize the sacrifices veterans and their families made for our country.

I’ll always honor their service and do all I can for those who dedicated themselves to fighting to protect the freedoms we enjoy every day. https://t.co/mBdIXb6eoi

At a time of significant biomedical breakthroughs for Parkinson’s Disease and so many other neurological disorders, we must keep our foot on the gas.

Proud to join Parkinson's Foundation Florida's Broward Community Walk to raise awareness and honor those impacted by Parkinson’s. https://t.co/THzV7YtZjA

If ripping food assistance away from 5 million Americans wasn't enough, Trump is now making it even harder to access SNAP benefits for 6 million more.

Working families deserve to eat. This cruelty ends on January 3rd. https://t.co/HY5FLYYnfX

Today, we mark the anniversary of Kristallnacht, the Night of Broken Glass—a deadly, horrific moment in Jewish history.

By resisting the rise of antisemitism, we honor the memory of millions who perished in the Holocaust and ensure atrocities like this never again take place. https://t.co/4xMZ7ZbbCQ

posts.text: Happy Diwali! May this Festival of Lights bring hope, happiness, and abundance to families and communities in Broward County and everywhere. https://t.co/J0stTYuSaN

Life needs to be more affordable. That's issue 1, 2, and 3 for the new Democratic Congress.

The days of Trump taking money from American families and giving it to billionaires are over. https://t.co/F512S2HZSb

So many friends, family and neighbors live with diabetes, yet healthcare is out of financial reach for too many of them.

This November, during American Diabetes Month, please support those impacted by diabetes, by demanding access to affordable, quality health care, prevention, and treatment for all.

Americans want lower costs.

Democrats will build on our housing success, reenact the ACA tax credits to bring down healthcare costs, and end Trump's war in Iran to bring down gas prices. https://t.co/lmIQW9oT7F

The new Democratic majority in Congress is determined to bring down costs and revive the American Dream.

Trump can be Mr. Veto or Mr. Dealmaker, but either way the days of unchecked corruption will end. https://t.co/vBpuxqyKgm

So glad to join @JetBlue and @FlaPanthers for the unveiling of the new “Go Cats Go” Airbus A320 at FLL!

The Panthers and JetBlue are key members of the Broward community and I’ll always support them both. 🏒 ✈️ #FlaPanthers https://t.co/rFV8yBum3h

Americans were very clear: Enough of MAGA's cruelty, corruption and high costs.

I'll work non-stop with our new Democratic House majority to ensure that happens.

TODAY is Election Day! Florida, let’s get out and VOTE. Polls are open from 7 AM until 7 PM.

Reproductive freedom, gun safety, affordable health care & more are on the ballot but you have to vote to make your voice heard.

Find your voting site: https://t.co/fElFWx89eO https://t.co/Agen4JzScn

TOMORROW is Election Day! If you haven’t already voted, now is the time to make a plan. Polls will be open from 7AM to 7PM.

If you're a Broward voter, find your voting site at https://t.co/fElFWx89eO https://t.co/zKEC8qLubO

ACA Open Enrollment started! Sign up by December 15 for coverage that starts January 1.

Prices are changing because Republicans gave tax breaks to billionaires instead of making healthcare affordable, so be sure to review your options.

Sign up: https://t.co/iQO5Wveq50

Families have to spend thousands more to get by under Trump. That's unacceptable.

As Republicans serve billionaires and huge corporations, Democrats fight to make life less expensive for all of us. https://t.co/G9oZ4mv1H4

Today is the LAST DAY left to vote early in Florida for the Nov. 3rd election.

If you haven’t voted already and can’t vote on Election Day, make a plan to vote today. Don’t miss out!

Find Broward County's early voting sites here. 👇 https://t.co/bIjr2bnQay

Whether you trick-or-treating or hand out candy tonight, Happy Halloween Broward County!

Wishing everyone a safe and fun holiday – and remember: don’t 'boo,' vote! https://t.co/pH0SniGmlx

On the last day of #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth, please schedule a mammogram if you haven't yet.

Over 60% of breast cancer diagnoses are detected early, but we can do even better. Early detection saves lives. As a cancer survivor, I know that firsthand. https://t.co/h9OPBrl0T4

Trump is draining the wallets of seniors at the pharmacy.

Democrats are fighting to ensure our seniors can stay healthy without breaking the bank. https://t.co/7INGed2rGY

Kids deserve the classic trick-or-treat experience we all loved growing up. 

But like all good things, Trump is determined to ruin Halloween.

Trump’s tariffs and his costly war in Iran have made even candy too expensive. https://t.co/Y7Zzx4mKxR

I proudly created the Alcee L. Hastings Program for Advanced Cancer Screening in Underserved Communities in honor of my late friend and mentor to knock down barriers to screen for this deadly disease.

I've secured $45M for this program, and I'll never stop fighting for more.

This is fantastic news! Forcing cancer patients to jump through hoops to get care is cruel.

@RepJoeNeguse and I led all @HouseDemocrats to demand Trump overturn these barriers to care. We'll keep the pressure on until healthcare is affordable and accessible for all Americans. https://t.co/oTFnUbGoek

Republicans made it harder for Americans to access healthcare by scrapping auto-renewal and adding more paperwork to the ACA.

It’s red tape, put there on purpose to make it harder for people to stay healthy. https://t.co/hvOlga0goV

Since my own cancer battle, I'm determined to fight for others at risk. Nobody should face this alone.

Proud to pass my EARLY Act to increase breast cancer awareness and ensure more people catch it early, survive and thrive. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth https://t.co/a6vg7NeYI0

Beef, coffee, rent and gas prices are all soaring. 

The average family in my district pays over $4,000 extra for these essentials since Trump took office. It must end.

I'm fighting to end the high-cost, corrupt MAGA agenda in Congress.

A neo-Nazi murdered eleven people 8 years ago today at Pittsburgh's Tree of Life synagogue, the largest ever antisemitic mass shooting in the U.S.

We will always remember the victims of this senseless tragedy, and must continue the fight against antisemitism and gun violence. https://t.co/Io5QzY6yyy

posts.text:
Families paid more for groceries last year thanks to Trump. While his tariffs made costs skyrocket, his Big Ugly Bill slashed food assistance for millions.

Republicans abandoned working families. Democrats will make life more affordable  and support those who need it. https://t.co/IcKk0SlsTo

Trick or treat? Under Trump, it’s all trick. 🎃

Parents are stocking up for Halloween right now, but candy is up 15% this year. 

That’s four times overall inflation. 

And that's no treat. https://t.co/rDbrHUBMBE

Gas prices are through the roof thanks to Trump.

Everything should be on the table: ending Trump's illegal war in Iran, raising wages, crackdowns on oil price gouging.

We must stop driving up prices for American families. https://t.co/CNxY58z4HI

I work hard to make sure mammograms are accessible and affordable – and I passed the PALS Act into law to protect access to these vital screenings for women in their 40s.

It’s so important to catch breast cancer early. Schedule your mammogram today! #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth https://t.co/E6Y2d0ZZ9S

Electricity costs have skyrocketed since Trump took office.

Instead of hiking prices on American families, Congress needs to get to work lowering them. Democrats stand ready to do so. https://t.co/nntQbMY92X

Grocery prices are up hundreds of dollars since Trump took office thanks to his illegal tariffs and rampant corporate price gouging.

Republicans in Congress are too chicken to stop it. Democrats are standing up and fighting back. https://t.co/AiTEgkMG6J

🚨 Broward voters 🚨 

Today is the LAST DAY to get a mail-in ballot for the November elections!

Sign up before 5PM at https://t.co/k8AbrjHA2n

I'm so proud to represent this fantastic community that comes together to improve quality of life for our kids.

@NSUFlorida's 'A Day For Children' gives valuable resources to help Broward County kids stay healthy. https://t.co/vOcQvVazNb

Families in my district have had to pay $4,400 more because of Trump's policies.

 🏠 $1,000+ more on rent and mortgages.
🩺 $1,000+ more on healthcare.
⛽ $800+ more on gas.
🥩 $300+ more on groceries.

I'm fighting to end the high costs and make life more affordable.

After MAGA ripped health care and food assistance away from seniors and DOGE raided Social Security offices and data, monthly SSI checks will only go up 3.6% - barely a tank of gas.

While Republicans ignore the cost crisis, Democrats are fighting for an affordable America.

Constituents reach out to my office all the time for help with federal agencies.

If you have trouble with a federal agency, contact my office and we can help you cut through red tape.

Reach out at https://t.co/EWdn2876XQ. https://t.co/eE2BKPZz5z
My full statement: https://t.co/z5LkHRAYBx

Today, like other Members, my district office received a suspicious letter. I’m thankful Sunrise Police and first responders acted swiftly to ensure my staff’s safety. Cowardly acts of intimidation like this will not work. They have no place in our politics and must be condemned. https://t.co/w7cedz9VMw

Gas prices jumped over 9 percent in just ONE MONTH. 

They're up more than 34 percent over the last year.

We must end Trump's illegal war in Iran and stop driving up prices for American families.

Gas now tops $4 a gallon, with diesel over $6, all thanks to Trump's illegal and reckless Iran war and tariffs.

Democrats are fighting to end the war, cancel the tariffs, and crack down on Trump corruption, so our government can prioritize American families once again. https://t.co/kbNuOeOEId

Early voting for the critical November elections start tomorrow!

Find an early voting site near you, and make a plan to vote. https://t.co/yzOTaybsP2

As prices soar, MAGA Republicans force hardworking Americans to pay the price for all their wasteful cruelty and rampant corruption.

Democrats are fighting back to lower costs and make this economy work for all of us.

About 1 in 8 women in the U.S. will develop breast cancer.

This #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth, take time today to put you and your health first. Early detection is our best tool to beat breast cancer. https://t.co/ZodOJRFsIW

Republicans rubber-stamped Trump’s tariffs, and now Americans pay more for everyday items.

Democrats are working to cancel Trump's illegal tariffs and deliver real relief. https://t.co/bSp8qAny0w

I joined @RepGregoryMeeks and @HouseForeign Democrats on a bill to block Trump's corrupt oil deal with Russia.

We must reverse this senseless betrayal of our Ukrainian allies. https://t.co/07hNerrSv9

It’s National #MammographyDay!

Mammograms should be accessible and affordable. I passed the PALS Act l to protect access to vital screenings for women ages 40-49.

As a survivor, I know firsthand how critical it is to catch breast cancer early. Schedule your mammogram today! https://t.co/fAkkWZRggI

If you need help with a federal agency, or want to share how Republicans' affordability crisis has impacted you, don't hesitate to reach out at https://t.co/EWdn2876XQ.

The federal government should be working for you, and my team is here to ensure that happens. https://t.co/1yrBcratxA

My heart is with @CongressmanRaja, Aurora, and the Hindu and Indian American communities. Thanks to the first responders and citizens that stopped this potentially deadly attack.

The FBI must investigate this and we must protect houses of worship from acts of violence and hate. https://t.co/B290t6mluC

From the gas pump to home heating oil, energy prices have soared. Trump promised lower costs, but his illegal war in Iran just drives them higher.

Trump did this to us. But Democrats are fighting to fix it. https://t.co/zsFKpjqjf9

🚨 Broward voters 🚨 

There’s only one week to get a mail-in ballot for the November elections!

Sign up before 5PM on 10/22:
https://t.co/k8AbrjHA2n

Trump lifted sanctions on Russian oil to fund Putin's war, and now directed his friend Elon Musk to cut off Ukraine's access to the internet and military communications.

This won't bring peace. It will only fuel Putin's brutality and cause more civilian deaths and suffering. https://t.co/U4bmI8yh3g

Proud to stand with all @HouseForeign Democrats to reject Trump's corrupt deal with Putin.

Funding Russia's war won't lower prices. We’ll kill this deal, cancel Trump's tariffs, and end his disastrous Iran war to deliver real relief to Americans. https://t.co/tfPOn2RU1z

I returned to the Miramar ICE facility for another surprise oversight visit. While the conditions are still unsafe and unhygienic, it's clear that public pressure is yielding results.

I'll keep fighting to rein in this dangerous, unconstitutional abuse of our neighbors. https://t.co/QdtFI9kp5m

Less than a week until early voting starts in Broward!

If you're a Broward voter, you can vote at any Broward polling location from October 19 to November 1, from 7AM to 7PM.

Find an early vote site near you, and make a plan to vote. https://t.co/SAQ8WnqR5q

Glad to sit down with The Recording Academy's Broward representatives to discuss how I can support the arts with AI looming.

AI offers great potential, but we must enact guardrails to protect creativity and ensure the arts center human creators. https://t.co/TD5g1iG1Ep

On #IndigenousPeoplesDay, we honor and celebrate Indigenous communities that have endured across generations and continue to shape our country. 

The Seminole and Miccosukee Tribes are central to South Florida history, and I’ll always support their safety and sovereignty. https://t.co/X4iXxIiO8v

Earlier this year, I saw ICE detaining people with no criminal record for weeks in a space designed to hold them for less than 12 hours.

With help from @OversightDems, we forced them to comply with the law and clean up their act. We must keep up the pressure. https://t.co/5Q106CFQcX

A pleasure to join leaders committed to affordable housing and delivering the American Dream at the Realtors Association's Broward Mayors Breakfast.

With the More Homes on the Market Act, Making Condos Safer and Affordable Act and more, I'm fighting for just that in Congress. https://t.co/i3968odjgD

TPS is for law-abiding immigrants who fled treacherous conditions.

They work hard, pass backgrounds checks, and do everything right. Yet Trump revoked their status anyway, sending them back into danger.

We must restore TPS and make the American Dream a reality again. https://t.co/2QLOfjoVoJ

The idea you're home free when you survive cancer is a myth - there are so many challenges and changes that come. As a breast cancer survivor, I know it firsthand.

Clean cooking is critical to life after cancer and ensures survivors can thrive. https://t.co/t2wfbR4Tt1

It’s Breast Cancer Awareness Month! That means it’s a great time to schedule your mammogram and start doing regular self-exams.

We must make this testing more accessible and invest in breast cancer research and awareness campaigns. I'll keep fighting for that in Congress. https://t.co/b3X9AhMVzb

When I conducted a surprise inspection of Alligator Alcatraz, I asked about "The Box," ICE's inhumane punishment device.

They lied to my face and said it didn't exist.

We must keep the pressure on to overhaul ICE and end the cruelty. https://t.co/UsrVE7vLZR

It looks like the worst of Hurricane Isaias will miss South Florida, but please urge your Panhandle family and friends to prepare for the worst. We saw what Milton did. 

Share my hurricane preparedness guide to ensure those you love are safe:
https://t.co/fgehBfOOdM https://t.co/cJgzIZSX9v

Beating cancer is hard enough. We can't leave those finishing active treatment alone in a wilderness.

My Lainie Jones Comprehensive Cancer Survivorship Act gives cancer centers and local groups the resources to build structured exercise regimens to keep survivors in remission. https://t.co/wdfbfMSOlJ
